entries.title: Luke 5:1
segments: And it happened that the crowd pressed on Him to hear the word of God, He stood by the lake of Gennesaret.

entries.title: Luke 5:2
segments: And He saw two boats standing by the lake. But the fishermen had left them and were washing [their] nets.

entries.title: Luke 5:3
segments: And He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, He asked him to thrust out a little from the land. And He sat down and taught the people out of the boat.

entries.title: Luke 5:4
segments: And as He stopped speaking, He said to Simon, Launch out into the deep and let your nets down for a haul.

entries.title: Luke 5:5
segments: And answering, Simon said to Him, Master, we have toiled all the night and have taken nothing. Yet at Your word I will let down the net.

entries.title: Luke 5:6
segments: And doing this, they enclosed a great multitude of fish. And their net was being torn.

entries.title: Luke 5:7
segments: And they signaled the partners, those in the other boat, to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they were sinking.

entries.title: Luke 5:8
segments: And seeing, Simon Peter fell at the knees of Jesus, saying, Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.

entries.title: Luke 5:9
segments: For he and all who were with him were astonished at the haul of fish which they had taken,

entries.title: Luke 5:10
segments: and so also [were] James and John, [the] sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, Do not fear, from now on you will be taking men alive.

entries.title: Luke 5:11
segments: And bringing their boats onto land, forsaking all things, they followed Him.

entries.title: Luke 5:12
segments: And it happened, as He was in a certain city, behold, a man full of leprosy! And seeing Jesus, he fell on [his] face and begged Him, saying, Lord, if You will, You can cleanse me.

entries.title: Luke 5:13
segments: And stretching out the hand, He touched him, saying, I will! Be clean! And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

entries.title: Luke 5:14
segments: And He commanded him, Tell no one, but go and show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing, as Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

entries.title: Luke 5:15
segments: But the word about Him spread even more. And great crowds were coming to hear, and to be healed from their infirmities by Him.

entries.title: Luke 5:16
segments: But He was drawing back in the wilderness, and praying.

entries.title: Luke 5:17
segments: And it happened on one of the days, even He was teaching. And Pharisees and teachers of [the] Law were sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee and Judea and Jerusalem. And [the] power of [the] Lord was there, for the curing [of] them.

entries.title: Luke 5:18
segments: And behold, men carrying, on a cot, a man who was paralyzed. And they sought to bring him in and to lay [him] before Him.

entries.title: Luke 5:19
segments: And not finding a way by [which] they might bring him in through the crowd, going up on the housetop, they let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst, before Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 5:20
segments: And seeing their faith, He said to him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

entries.title: Luke 5:21
segments: And the scribes and Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, except God alone?

entries.title: Luke 5:22
segments: But knowing their thoughts, answering, Jesus said to them, Why do you reason in your hearts?

entries.title: Luke 5:23
segments: Which is easier, to say, Your sins are forgiven you; or to say, Rise up and walk?

entries.title: Luke 5:24
segments: But so that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins, He said to the paralytic, I say to you, Arise, and take up your cot [and] go to your house.

entries.title: Luke 5:25
segments: And immediately he rose up before them and took up [that] on which he lay. And he departed to his own house, glorifying God.

entries.title: Luke 5:26
segments: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God and were filled [with] fear, saying, We saw wonderful things today.

entries.title: Luke 5:27
segments: And after these things He went out and saw a tax-collector named Levi, sitting at the tax-office. And [He] said to him, Follow Me.

entries.title: Luke 5:28
segments: And leaving all, he rose up and followed Him.

entries.title: Luke 5:29
segments: And Levi made a great feast in his own house for Him. And there was a great company of tax-collectors and of others who were reclining with them.

entries.title: Luke 5:30
segments: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against His disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with tax-collectors and sinners?

entries.title: Luke 5:31
segments: And Jesus answered and said to them, Those who are sound do not need a physician, but those who are sick.

entries.title: Luke 5:32
segments: I did not come to call the righteous to repentance, but sinners.

entries.title: Luke 5:33
segments: And they said to Him, Why do John's disciples fast often and make prayers, and also [the disciples] of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?

entries.title: Luke 5:34
segments: But He said to them, Can you make the sons of the bridechamber fast while the bridegroom is with them?

entries.title: Luke 5:35
segments: But the days will come when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast in those days.

entries.title: Luke 5:36
segments: And He also spoke a parable to them: No one puts a piece of a new garment on an old garment. Otherwise, both the new will tear, and [the old] does not match [the] piece from the new.

entries.title: Luke 5:37
segments: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. Else the new wine will burst the wineskins and be spilled, and the wineskin will perish.

entries.title: Luke 5:38
segments: But new wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved together.

entries.title: Luke 5:39
segments: Also no one having drunk old [wine] immediately desires new, for he says, The old is better.
